response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished senior full-stack/web engineer with strong software craftsmanship, but the role requires a Principal Performance Architect specializing in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator performance analysis, and hardware-software co-design. The resume shows no experience in silicon architecture, GPU/accelerator workload analysis, SIMD/MIMD architectures, or deep-learning performance optimization, making this a fundamental domain mismatch despite the candidate's seniority and tenure.
strengths: 18+ years of software engineering experience, exceeding the years-of-experience bar
Some low-latency systems work (DLang, async I/O, high-throughput microservices at Dunnhumby)
Strong open-source contributions and evidence of self-driven technical depth
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, silicon architecture, or hardware performance modeling experience
No background in deep-learning training/inference optimization or GPU/accelerator workload analysis
Career trajectory is web/product engineering, far from principal-level hardware performance architecture

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator or DL workload optimization background
Long tenure and some systems-level/low-latency work
